spec.description: A shop for one outside collection. The coin is SHOP. The creator loads ten of their own NFTs and seeds SHOP worth two sell-backs. After graduation anyone picks an NFT for twice the sell-back price, and any holder of the collection can sell one back, within weekly limits. The list is fixed: no curator and no new collections. The last NFT stays. Buyers fees go to holders. Sellers fees buy SHOP for the shop up to twice its seed; excess goes to holders. Sepolia test setup in ETH. The collection is Test Junk Bent Cans, an owner-minted test stand-in.
